name: Assisting Arch Druid Runetotem
summary: The Cenarion Circle in Thunder Bluff seeks seasoned adventurers for a research project led by Hamuul Runetotem. You are asked to speak with him on the Elder Rise.

sections.title: A Call to Speak
sections.body: The Cenarion Circle seeks your aid in a research project in Thunder Bluff. Hamuul Runetotem leads the work, though its details are not known to the one who directs you there. Speak with the Arch Druid on the Elder Rise.

faq.answer: Arch Druid Hamuul Runetotem is leading the Cenarion Circle's research project.

faq.q: Where can I speak with Hamuul?
faq.answer: Hamuul Runetotem is on the Elder Rise in Thunder Bluff.
The Cenarion Circle seeks aid with a vital research project, but its details are not known to the one directing you to Hamuul.
The Cenarion Circle in Thunder Bluff is seeking seasoned adventurers to aid its research project.
